{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[
{"@type":"Question","name":"What is Steel.dev and what does it do?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Steel.dev is cloud browser infrastructure for AI agents. It is not a visual collaboration tool, iPaaS, or AI agent itself. Steel.dev gives AI agents isolated cloud browser sessions with built-in anti-bot stealth, CAPTCHA solving, and session persistence."}},
{"@type":"Question","name":"Is Steel.dev an open source project?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes. Steel Browser is the open-source server on GitHub (github.com/steel-dev) you can self-host. Steel Cloud is the managed version adding scale, stealth, proxies, and CAPTCHA solving."}},
{"@type":"Question","name":"Is Steel.dev an AI agent or AI infrastructure?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Steel.dev is infrastructure, not an agent. Your agent—built with OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, or custom code—connects to Steel, which handles browser lifecycle, stealth, session persistence, and proxies."}},
{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I use Steel.dev with Playwright, Puppeteer, or Selenium?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes. Steel.dev works with Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, and its own Node and Python SDKs. You connect via a standard CDP WebSocket URL, so any CDP-compatible tool works out of the box."}},
{"@type":"Question","name":"How fast is Steel.dev at starting browser sessions?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Under one second on average with no cold-start penalty. Each session launches into a fully isolated cloud Chromium browser with proxy, cookies, and storage preconfigured."}},
{"@type":"Question","name":"How can I run headless browsers in the cloud for web scraping?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Steel.dev provides managed cloud browser sessions for scraping and AI automation. Unlike basic headless setups, Steel handles anti-bot stealth, CAPTCHA solving, residential proxies, and session persistence in one API via Playwright, Puppeteer, or Selenium."}},
{"@type":"Question","name":"How does Steel.dev compare to Browserbase for browser automation?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Both provide cloud browser infrastructure for AI agents. Steel.dev differentiates with its open-source server, sub-second startup, persistent browser profiles, live session viewer for human-in-the-loop debugging, and vendor-neutral CDP API."}},
{"@type":"Question","name":"Does Steel.dev support human-in-the-loop workflows and auth context reuse?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes. A live session viewer lets humans watch or take over running sessions. Persistent browser profiles save cookies and session tokens so agents resume authenticated workflows without re-login."}},
{"@type":"Question","name":"How much does Steel.dev cost and is there a free tier?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Steel.dev offers predictable monthly pricing by concurrent sessions. Proxies and stealth are included with no per-request or idle-time fees. Steel Browser is free and open source. See steel.dev/pricing for plans."}},
{"@type":"Question","name":"What are the best cloud browser automation tools for AI agents?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Leading options include Steel.dev, Browserbase, and Kernel. Steel.dev stands out with its open-source server, sub-second startup, persistent profiles, live debugging, and Playwright/Puppeteer/Selenium support via standard CDP."}}
]}
